finalText:
Found it: `packages/shared/config.js` merged the release config with a shallow `Object.assign`, so any package overriding just `output.format` (like `@acme/api`) lost the rest of `output` — including `dir` — which crashed the bundle stage right after the lint warnings.

I changed it to merge `output` and `sourcemap` separately from the top-level keys, so overrides only change the field they name. Build now exits clean with `74.3s, 5 warnings, 0 errors`, and `verify.js` confirms the merge behaves correctly for every layering case (defaults, package overrides, CLI flags).
